title: Master's and doctoral bursary
field: Master's and doctoral research at Unisa
about: Unisa's 2027 Master's and Doctoral Bursary supports registered Unisa research students. Applications are online via myUnisa from 21 September to 30 November 2026; supervisors must support applications by 31 January 2027.
requirements: Online applications through myUnisa only, 21 September - 30 November 2026
Supervisor must support the application by 31 January 2027; temporary registration by 31 January 2027
Master's students first registered 2024-2026; doctoral students first registered 2021-2026
New applicants must have passed their research proposal by 31 January 2027
